senses.gloss: ch. same; part. חַטְיָא used to comfort, tender, delicate.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 33:13">Targ. Y. Gen. XXXIII, 13</cite> <he>טליא חַטְיָין</he> (h. text <he>רכים</he>).

senses.gloss: to cause to be generous, to persuade to leniency.
units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 9:18:2">Koh. R. to IX, 18</cite> <he>אנא אזלא ומְחַטָּא ליה</he> I will go to appeal to his generosity (Midr. Sam. ch. XXXII <he>ומפייסה</he>).

senses.gloss: to be raised in luxury. Part. pass. מִחְטֵי, fem. מֶחְטָיָא, מֶחְטַיְיתָא delicate.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 28:54">Targ. Y. I Deut. XXVIII, 54</cite>, <cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Deuteronomy 28:54">Targ. Y. II, Deut. XXVIII, 54</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Deuteronomy 28:56">56</cite>.
